purpose: FIFTY-SECOND catalogue entry - THE PREDICTION'S JUDGE: fetched to score the v1.77.0 falsifiable KTB Vp prediction, and although the eleven predicted depths are transport-unreachable, the co-located DTCO+RHOB pairs deliver the decisive test of the chain's disclosed assumption: at matched density 2.80-2.90 g/cm3, KTB's own measured Vp is 6,228 m/s mean (5,537-6,519, n=11) versus the 504B-prior prediction of 5,675 +/- 109 - the cross-site transfer (oceanic basalt prior applied to continental gneiss) is REFUTED at ~+10 percent / ~5 sigma, exactly the failure mode the engine disclosed on every estimate before the data arrived; the UQFF constants layer (validated 0.9968) is NOT implicated - the provincial prior is
